claim: Employing a non-Jordanian is illegal if there is no permit or the permit has been expired for up to 90 days, if the worker works for an employer other than the one on the permit without MOL permission, or in another occupation
quote: استخدامه دون الحصول على تصريح عمل أو بتصريح عمل منتهي المدة بما لا يزيد على تسعين يوما

claim: Working for an employer other than the one on the permit, without permission from MOL, is a violation
quote: استخدامه لـدى صاحب عمل غير المصرح لـه بالـعمـل لديـه مـا لـم يكـن حاصلا علـى أذن بـذلك مـن الجهة المختصـة في الوزارة

claim: The Minister orders deportation of a non-Jordanian worker who breaks Art. 12, including a worker MOL finds has left the employer, or who works without a permit
quote: مخالفـة العامـل لأحكام هـذه المـادة بمـا فـي ذلـك الـعامـل الذي ثبت للوزارة تركه العمل لدى صاحب العمل

claim: Deportation is carried out at the expense of the violator with whom the worker was caught, and the deported worker may not be recruited or employed again for at least five years
quote: ولا يجوز إعادة استقدام أو استخدام العامل غير الأردني الذي يتم تسفيره قبـل مـضـي خمس سنوات على الأقل من تاريخ تنفيذ قرار التسفير

claim: The deportation is carried out at the expense of the violator with whom the worker was caught
quote: يتم تنفيذ قرار التسفير من قبل السلطات المختصة على نفقة المخالف الذي تم ضبط العامل لديه

claim: An employer or intermediary who employs a non-Jordanian unlawfully is fined at least twice the permit fees for the sector, four times on repeat; the permit-holding employer who did not report the worker leaving before the worker was caught elsewhere gets the same fine
quote: صاحب العمل الذي صدر تصريح العمل باسمه ولم يقم بإبلاغ الوزارة عـن تـرك العامـل العمـل لـديـه قبـل ضبطه يعمـل لدى صاحب عمل آخر

claim: In November 2025 the ministries of interior and labour and the PSD said any worker caught working without a valid permit or in an unauthorised profession will be deported immediately
quote: any worker caught working without a valid work permit or in a profession they are not authorized for will be immediately deported

claim: Under Art. 11 of the Residence and Foreigners Affairs Law No. 24 of 1973, any foreigner staying over two weeks must register with the PSD; breaches of Arts 11 or 14 carry a JD 200 fine
quote: any foreigner staying in Jordan for more than two weeks must register with the Public Security Directorate or its branches

claim: Violating Articles 11 or 14 carries a JD 200 fine
quote: Violating Articles 11 or 14 carries a JD 200 fine under Article 36

claim: Anyone sheltering, housing or employing runaway workers faces legal action and possible human trafficking charges
quote: anyone harboring or employing runaway workers, providing housing or work, or attempting to exploit workers will face legal accountability

claim: The 2026 regularisation period gave a 50% exemption on past permit fees, 100% exemption from late-renewal fines when renewing or moving to a new employer, and 100% exemption from overstay fines for those who regularised
quote: includes a 50% exemption on work permit fees for all previous periods, applicable to employers or violating non-Jordanian workers across various sectors

claim: Workers leaving for good during the period got a 100% exemption from past permit fees and penalties and from overstay fines, provided their official file is settled
quote: violating non-Jordanian workers who wish to leave the Kingdom permanently (final departure) will receive a 100% exemption from all previous work permit fees and penalties accumulated up to their departure date

claim: MOL said it would issue a deportation order for any violating non-Jordanian worker who had not regularised from 1 October 2026
quote: the Ministry will issue a deportation order for any violating non-Jordanian worker—including domestic workers—who fails to rectify their status in accordance with the Labor Law and the Residency and Foreigners Affairs Law, effective October 1, 2026

claim: 100% exemption from late renewal penalties when renewing an expired permit or transferring to a new employer
quote: a 100% exemption from late renewal penalties for employers or non-Jordanian workers when renewing an expired work permit or transferring to a new employer across all economic sectors

claim: Under the amended Residence and Foreigners Affairs Law, not applying to renew an annual residence permit within one month of its expiry is fined JD 90 a month, or JD 3 a day
quote: had not applied for renewal of the annual residency permit within one month of its expiration date, will be fined JD90 for each month, or three dinars per day

claim: The 2025 amendment raised the daily fine for late residence renewal or rectification from JD 1.5 to JD 3
quote: proposes an increase in fines from 1.5 JDs to 3 JDs for each day of delay in rectifying violations or renewing permits

claim: In 2018 Bangladeshi and Indian workers at Al Hassan Industrial Estate complained that factories delayed renewing their work and residence permits for months or years, so workers could not go home without paying overstay fines
quote: since employers do not issue labour or residency permits for the workers, they cannot return to their home countries without paying overstay fines

claim: Workers said several months had passed since some work permits expired, and years in extreme cases
quote: several months have passed since the work permits of some workers expired, and even years in other extreme cases

claim: A worker may not strike without giving the employer at least 14 days' notice (doubled in public-interest services)
quote: لا يجوز للعامل ان يضرب دون إعطاء إشعار لصاحب العمل قبل مدة لا تقل عن أربعة عشر يوما من التاريخ المحدد للإضراب

claim: No strike is allowed while the dispute is before a conciliation officer, conciliation council or labour court, or while a settlement or decision on the issue is in force
quote: إذا كان النزاع محالا على مندوب التوفيق أو مجلس التوفيق أو المحكمة العمالية

claim: A worker in a prohibited strike is fined at least JD 50 for the first day and JD 5 for each further day, and loses wages for strike days
quote: إذا قام أي عامل بإضراب محظور بموجب هذا القانون يعاقب بغرامة لا تقل عن خمسين دينارا عن اليوم الأول وخمسة دنانير عن كل يستمر فيه الإضراب بعد ذلك ويحرم من أجره عن الأيام التي يضرب فيها

claim: After Tureza Akter's death many Fine Apparel workers went on strike, against local laws; they demanded the abusive supervisor and two male managers be sacked and the company agreed
quote: Many [workers] went on strike, despite this protest being against local laws

claim: The workers demanded the supervisor and two male managers be sacked; the company agreed
quote: The workers demanded that the supervisor who abused Ms Akter should be sacked, together with two male managers. The company agreed, according to the report

claim: Using or possessing drugs for personal use (main schedules) is punished with 1 to 3 years in prison and a fine of JD 1,000-3,000
quote: بالحبس مدة لا تقل عن سنة ولا تزيد على ثلاث سنوات وبغرامة لا تقل عن ألف دينار ولا تزيد على ثلاثة آلاف دينار

claim: A first personal-use offence is not recorded as a criminal record or security record
quote: لا يعتبر اي فعل من الأفعال المشار إليها في الفقرة (أ) من هذه المادة سابقة جرمية أو قيدا أمنيا بحق مرتكبه للمرة الأولى

claim: Being drunk in a public place with rowdy behaviour disturbing people, or indecent behaviour in public, is punished with up to three months in prison and/or a fine of JD 100-200
quote: يعاقب بالحبس مدة لا تزيد على ثلاثة أشهر أو بغرامة لا تقل عـن مـائـة دينـار ولا تزيـد علـى مـائتي دينـار أو بكلتـا هـاتين العقوبتين كل من

claim: The offence covers being drunk in a public place and behaving rowdily or disturbing people
quote: وجـد فـي محـل عـام أو مكـان مـبـاح للجمهور وهـو فـي حالـة السكر وتصرف تصرفا مقرونا بالشغب وإزعاج الناس

claim: Being found clearly drunk or under drugs at work, or committing an act against public morals at the workplace, allows dismissal without notice
quote: إذا وجد أثناء العمل في حالة سكر بين أو متأثرا بما تعاطاه من مادة مخدرة أو مؤثر عقلي أو ارتكب عملا مخلا بالآداب العامة في مكان العمل

claim: No one may bring alcoholic drinks or drugs into the workplace or be there under their influence
quote: The employer or employee may not permit the entry or exhibition of any kind of alcoholic beverages, drugs, narcotics, or dangerous drugs to the places of work

claim: Issuing a cheque in bad faith without sufficient funds is punished with one year in prison and a fine of JD 100-200; if the cheque is paid or the complainant drops the claim, a fine of 5% of its value (JD 100-5,000) applies
quote: يعاقب بالحبس مدة سنة وبغرامة لا تقل عن مائة دينار ولا تزيد على مائتي دينار كل من اقدم بسوء نية على ارتكاب احد الأفعال التالية

claim: If the cheque value is paid or the complaint dropped, a fine of 5% of the cheque value, between JD 100 and JD 5,000, is collected
quote: تستوفى غرامة تعادل (5 %) من قيمة الشيك مهما بلغ عدد المحكوم عليهم على أن لا تقل عن مائة دينار ولا تزيد على خمسة آلاف دينار

claim: An indecent act or gesture in a public place or visible from one is punished with up to one year in prison and a JD 200 fine, doubled if by several people or repeated
quote: يعاقب بالحبس مدة لا تزيد على سنة وبغرامة مقدارها مائتا دينار كل من فعل فعلا منافيا للحياء أو ابدى إشارة منافية للحياء في مكان عام

claim: Consensual zina (sex outside marriage) is punished with one to three years in prison, at least two years for a married person
quote: يعاقب الزاني والزانية برضاهما بالحبس من سنة الى ثلاث سنوات

claim: Zina is prosecuted only on a complaint by the husband or wife while the marriage lasts, or by the woman's guardian (wali); the complaint must be made within three months of learning of it and at most one year after the act
quote: لا يجوز ملاحقة الزاني أو الزانية الا بشكوى الزوج أو الزوجة ما دامت الزوجية قائمة بينهما ، وكذلك بشكوى ولي الزانية

claim: Cybercrime Law Art. 15: knowingly sending or publishing online false news targeting national security and social peace, or defaming, slandering or insulting any person, is punished with at least three months in prison and/or a fine of JD 5,000-20,000; prosecuted without complaint if aimed at state authorities
quote: تنطوي على أخبار كاذبة تستهدف الأمن الوطني والسلم المجتمعي، أو ذم، أو قدح، أو تحقير أي شخص بالحبس مدة لا تقل عن ثلاثة أشهر أو بغرامة لا تقل عن (5000) خمسة آلاف دينار ولا تزيد على (20000) عشرين ألف دينار

claim: Cybercrime Law Art. 17: online posts stirring sedition or strife, targeting social peace, inciting hatred or violence, or showing contempt for religions are punished with 1 to 3 years in prison and/or a fine of JD 5,000-20,000
quote: لنشر ما من شأنه إثارة الفتنة أو النعرات أو تستهدف السلم المجتمعي أو الحض على الكراهية أو الدعوة إلى العنف أو تبريره أو ازدراء الأديان بالحبس من سنة إلى ثلاث سنوات

claim: Cybercrime Law Art. 20: on complaint, publishing online a recording, photo or video of something a person keeps private, to defame or harm them or gain a benefit, is punished with at least three months in prison and a fine of JD 20,000-40,000
quote: يعاقب بناء على الشكوى بالحبس مدة لا تقل عن ثلاثة أشهر وبغرامة لا تقل عن (20000) عشرين ألف دينار ولا تزيد على (40000) أربعين ألف دينار

claim: Using another person's identity or forged certificates or documents allows dismissal without notice
quote: إذا انتحل العامل شخصية أو هوية غيره أو قدم شهادات أو وثائق مزورة بقصد جلب المنفعة لنفسه أو الإضرار بغيره

claim: Recruiting migrant workers under 18 is treated as human trafficking; in 2024 BWJ found three suspected child workers whose passports had falsified dates of birth
quote: The recruitment of migrant workers under 18 is treated as human trafficking under the rules of the Anti-Trafficking Unit

claim: In all three suspected child labour cases the passports had falsified dates of birth
quote: In all these cases, the workers' passports contained falsified dates of birth

claim: After incidents such as work stoppages or strikes, management may keep paperwork showing the worker resigned, or no termination documents at all
quote: paperwork to show that the worker had wilfully resigned or may not maintain any termination

claim: Unlawful terminations are usually identified by cross-checking workers' statements after incidents such as work stoppages or strikes
quote: Unlawful terminations are also difficult to justify through multiple sources and are usually dependent on cross-checking workers' statements following incidents such as work stoppages or strikes

claim: A worker may not be dismissed or disciplined because of complaints or claims made to the authorities about the Labour Law
quote: لا يجوز فصل العامل أو اتخاذ أي إجراء تأديبي بحقه لأسباب تتصل بالشكاوى والمطالبات التي تقدم بها العامل إلى الجهات المختصة

claim: Unified contract dispute route: complain to the union labour committee; if not settled in five days, to the General Trade Union; or, if the worker prefers, to the Ministry of Labour, the wage authority or the magistrates' court
quote: If the labor union committee fails to settle the dispute within five days, the worker may have recourse to the General Trade Union of Workers in Textile, Garment and Clothing Industry to resolve the complaint. If the worker does not wish to refer the matter to the union, he may file the complaint with the Ministry of Labor or the wage authority or court of peace

claim: MOL's Hemayah (protection) platform for labour complaints is at complaint.hemayeh.jo; keep the complaint number to follow it up
quote: يرجى الإحتفاظ برقم الشكوى للإستعلام من خلاله

claim: MOL's national call centre 06-5008080 works 24 hours
quote: مركز الاتصال الوطني يعمل على مدار 24 ساعة

claim: MOL takes complaints and inquiries by WhatsApp on 06-2221020 and 06-2221239
quote: 06-2221020 06-2221239 للشكاوى والإستفسارات عبر تطبيق الوتساب

claim: MOL is at 11 Issa Al-Naouri Street, Amman, open Sunday to Thursday 8:30am-3:30pm; phone +962 6 2221020
quote: الموقع: وزارة العمل الاردنية -شارع عيسى الناعوري 11،عمان

claim: MOL working hours are Sunday to Thursday 8:30 to 3:30
quote: ساعات العمل: من الأحد إلى الخميس، من الساعة 8:30 الى الساعة 3:30

claim: MOL's free line for work permit and Labour Law questions is 080022208; inspection, migrant labour and legal affairs 06-5802681 until 3:30pm; inspection directorate WhatsApp 06-5802660 and 06-5802661
quote: الاستفسارات المتعلقة بمسائل تصاريح العمل و قانون العمل، الخط المجاني

claim: Inspection directorate WhatsApp numbers 06-5802660 and 06-5802661
quote: (إضافة خدمة الوتس أب) ارقام خاصة لمديرية التفتيش

claim: Hemayah offers a confidential complaint option; a worker paid below the minimum wage should classify the complaint as non-payment of the minimum wage, not as non-payment of wages
quote: المنصة توفر خيار سرية الشكوى وأن يصنف شكوته أنها تتعلق بعدم الإلتزام بدفع الحد الأدنى للأجور وليس خيار عدم دفع الأجور

claim: Hemayah received only 106 minimum-wage complaints from the start of 2025 to the date of the statement
quote: بلغ فقط 106 شكاوى عمالية منذ بداية العام الجاري 2025

claim: A labour inspector can order the employer to remove a violation within seven days of written warning; if not, the Minister may close the establishment until it is removed
quote: للمفتش الطلب من صاحب العمل إزالة المخالفة خلال مدة لا تزيد على سبعة أيام من تاريخ تبلغه إنذارا خطيا بذلك وفي حالة تخلفه فللوزير أو من يفوضه أن يقرر إغلاق المؤسسة

claim: MOL's Wage Authority unit hears wage cases in Amman governorate: shortfalls, illegal deductions, late pay, unpaid overtime, unequal pay; the worker can sue while still employed or within six months of leaving if the worker ended the contract
quote: تتولى النظر في القضايا العمالية ضمن محافظة العاصمة

claim: The worker can file while still in the job or within six months of leaving if the worker ended the contract
quote: وللعامل اقامة الدعوى سواء كان على رأس عمله أو خلال ستة شهور من تركه العمل إذا كان إنهاء العلاقة التعاقدية من طرف العامل

claim: The Wage Authority mediates at the worker's request if done within six months of the end of work
quote: تقوم بإجراء الوساطة بناء على طلب العامل لحل النزاع بينه وبين صاحب العمل ويشترط في ذلك أن تجري هذه الوساطة خلال مدة ستة أشهر من تاريخ انتهاء عمله

claim: The case is dropped if the worker who filed it does not attend; if the employer is absent it is decided in absentia; appeal within ten days if the award exceeds JD 100
quote: وتسقط الدعوى إذا تغيب العامل المدعي وتنظر فيها بحضوره إذا غاب صاحب العمل المدعى عليه

claim: Wage Authority decisions are enforced like court judgments, the amounts may not be paid in instalments, and the worker's claim and enforcement are free of fees and stamps
quote: ويعفى من الرسوم والطوابع الادعاء المقدم من العامل لسلطة الأجور وكذلك قراراتها المقدمة للتنفيذ إلى دوائر التنفيذ

claim: Decisions are enforced by the enforcement departments as if court judgments, without instalments
quote: قرارات وحدة سلطة الأجور يتم تنفيذها من قبل دوائر التنفيذ المختصة كأنها قرارات صادرة عن المحاكم النظامية شريطة أن لا تخضع المبالغ المحكوم بها للتقسيط

claim: In 2024 the Wage Authority registered 368 cases and decided 354
quote: وحدة سلطة الأجور فصلت بـ (354) دعوى عمالية في عام 2024

claim: The worker or the union on the worker's behalf files the claim in writing; several workers of one establishment with the same cause may file one claim; the employer must answer within ten days
quote: يقدم العامل نفسه أو نقابة العمال بالنيابة عنه الادعاء خطياً ويجوز تقديم ادعاء واحد من عدد من العمال إذا كانوا يعملون في المؤسسة ذاتها وكان سبب دعواهم واحداً

claim: The Wage Authority may order unpaid or illegally deducted wages paid and add compensation up to the amount withheld
quote: ولها أن تضيف تعويضاً تقدره شريطة أن لا يتجاوز مبلغ التعويض المبلغ المحسوم أو غير المدفوع

claim: Magistrates' courts hear individual labour disputes, including wage claims where there is no wage authority, urgently, deciding within three months; cases are free of all fees
quote: تختص محكمة الصلح بالنظر في الدعاوى الناشئة عن نزاعات العمل الفردية ومن ذلك الدعاوى المتعلقة بالأجور في المناطق التي لا يوجد فيها سلطة أجور
